_comment: Theme registry for the manifest-driven engine (keystone / DIC-568). Each entry is a theme manifest in this directory. `bootable` flags themes that can drive THIS (parcel) frontend; the theme-chooser pulldown appears only when >1 bootable theme is registered. lockport-township is the zoning-domain ZIP theme — not PV-bootable until ZIP's frontend runs on the shared engine (DIC-523).
